name: Counselors in Training (CIT), Bear Valley YMCA Resident Camp
city: Sacramento, CA (overnight camp at Bear Valley YMCA Camp, near Emigrant Gap in the High Sierra)
what_you_do: You spend a week at a High Sierra overnight camp learning to be camp staff. You help run evening activities, do team building, and stay in a cabin where you assist staff and campers.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 14 to 16. Every CIT who signs up gets an interview. Teens who are 17 can come as a Volunteer Junior Counselor. No city rule is stated.
pay_detail: $700 a week in 2026 (the same price as camper weeks). Y-Assist financial aid is available.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 sessions: June 28 to July 2 (Zero Week), July 5 to 10, July 12 to 17, July 19 to 24, and July 26 to 31, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Use the CIT Registration link on the Bear Valley page. Registering places you on a waitlist, and staff contact you to schedule a CIT interview.
notes: This is a camp program you pay for, not a job. Camp volunteers must be 17 or older and pass an interview. Y-Assist aid for camp is a separate application from YMCA membership aid; the page says replies take about 15 business days. Transportation to camp is not described on the page. Contact: BearValley@ymcasuperiorcal.org.
